## Activity

During April 2020, North City Eye Clinic completed 195 retinal image captures. This activity represents the total number of image sets submitted for assessment during the month. The service should continue to record completed captures consistently, as this supports monitoring of workload and capacity over time.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for assessment. A total of 5 captures were ungradable, giving an ungradable rate of 2.6%. Ungradable images cannot support a reliable clinical assessment and should be reviewed through routine quality monitoring. The result provides a useful measure for identifying any recurring problems with image acquisition or equipment.

## Grading

Grading identified 37 referable results during April 2020. These results require the appropriate onward process in line with service arrangements. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day, indicating that images were generally assessed promptly. Continued monitoring of the grading interval will help maintain timely review and support the consistent handling of referable findings.
